text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"$rebuildSnapshot = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path ('tmp/rebuild-start-' + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $rebuildSnapshot -Force | Out-Null; git rev-parse HEAD | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $rebuildSnapshot 'HEAD.txt') -Encoding utf8; git status --short | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $rebuildSnapshot 'status.txt') -Encoding utf8; git -c core.quotepath=false diff --binary | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $rebuildSnapshot 'tracked.patch') -Encoding utf8; $rebuildPaths = @(@(git -c core.quotepath=false diff --name-only --diff-filter=ACMRT); @(git -c core.quotepath=false ls-files --others --exclude-standard)) | Sort-Object -Unique; Add-Type -AssemblyName System.IO.Compression.FileSystem; $rebuildArchive = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open((Join-Path $rebuildSnapshot 'worktree-files.zip'),[System.IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create); try { foreach($rebuildPath in $rebuildPaths){ if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $rebuildPath -PathType Leaf){ [System.IO.Compression.ZipFileExtensions]::CreateEntryFromFile($rebuildArchive,(Join-Path (Get-Location).Path $rebuildPath),$rebuildPath,[System.IO.Compression.CompressionLevel]::Optimal) | Out-Null } } } finally {$rebuildArchive.Dispose()}; Copy-Item -LiteralPath 'tmp/realism-baseline.json' -Destination (Join-Path $rebuildSnapshot 'legacy-212-before.json'); Write-Output $rebuildSnapshot; Get-Item -LiteralPath (Join-Path $rebuildSnapshot 'worktree-files.zip') | Select-Object Length","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":500}));
text(await tools.web__run({find:[{ref_id:"turn0view0",pattern:"3.1.4"},{ref_id:"turn0view0",pattern:"eccentricity"}],screenshot:[{ref_id:"turn0view0",pageno:102}],response_length:"short"}));
